findings.evidence: The file declares only `[AddCommGroup N]` at line 52; `isOpenEmbedding_complexTorusAmbient` requires `[Finite ι]` at line 182, while the second-countable and locally-compact instances require both `Module.Free` and `Module.Finite` at lines 201 and 208.
findings.fix: Qualify the claims: coordinate equivalence is general, the open embedding requires finite `ι`, and second countability/local compactness require `[Module.Free ℤ N] [Module.Finite ℤ N]`.
findings.issue: The module docstring claims the character lattice is finitely generated, every free presentation has finitely many coordinates and gives an open embedding, and the torus is second countable and locally compact; these conclusions do not hold under the file's general `[AddCommGroup N]` context.

summary: The topology module docstring overstates finite-generation and finiteness-dependent conclusions without stating their required hypotheses.
